descriptions.lose_fat: Burn fat and keep your muscle
descriptions.build_muscle: Gain muscle with a small surplus
descriptions.stay_healthy: Feel fit and keep a balance

lose_fat.title: Losing fat is about consistency
lose_fat.body: A moderate calorie deficit and strength training let you lose fat while keeping your muscle. We'll set your daily target and a plan you can stick to.

build_muscle.title: Muscle grows with time and protein
build_muscle.body: Training close to your limit, enough protein and a small calorie surplus build muscle week by week. We'll calculate exactly what you need.

get_stronger.title: Strength comes from progression
get_stronger.body: Heavy compound lifts with enough rest, and a little more weight over time, make you stronger. Your plan will be built around them.

stay_healthy.title: Small habits, big difference
stay_healthy.body: Regular training and balanced meals keep you fit and full of energy. We'll make both fit into your week.

consent.intro: To create your plan, Benchbite needs some health data. That needs your explicit consent.

what.title: What we collect
what.body: Your sex, age, height, weight, activity and training.

why.title: Why
why.body: Only to calculate your calorie targets and your workout plan.

control.title: Your control
control.body: Stored securely and only visible to you. You can withdraw your consent and delete your data at any time.

consent.agree: I agree that Benchbite processes my health data for these purposes.

declined.title: A personal plan needs your consent
declined.body: Without health data, Benchbite can't calculate your targets or build your plan. You can change your mind at any time.

birthYear.tooYoung: Benchbite is for people aged 18 and over.

wrongDirection.lose_fat: To lose fat, your target has to be below your current weight.
wrongDirection.build_muscle: To build muscle, your target has to be above your current weight.

targetWeight.belowHealthy: This is below a healthy weight for your height. The lowest healthy target is {{weight}} {{unit}}.
targetWeight.alreadyLow: Your weight is already at the lower end of a healthy range, so losing fat is not recommended. Building muscle or staying healthy suits you better.

levels.aggressive: Aggressive: hard to keep up and less healthy

pace.disclaimer: These are estimates, not medical advice.

fastest.lose_fat: This is the fastest pace we recommend. Losing weight faster mostly costs muscle and is hard to keep up.
fastest.build_muscle: This is the fastest pace we recommend. Gaining weight faster mostly adds fat, not muscle.

descriptions.moderate: On your feet most of the day
